narratives.Overview:
## Summary

## Scope boundary

**Work lives only in `deftai/directive`.** Edit `README.md` (Getting Started) in this repo to link out to `https://github.com/deftai/directive-training`.

⊗ Do not change `deftai/directive-training` for this issue. No PRs, README edits, or course content work in the training repo.


Add a Getting Started pointer in the **Directive README** to the public training course repo [`deftai/directive-training`](https://github.com/deftai/directive-training) ("Training course for learning to use deft/directive").

## Why

New humans and agents land on `README.md` first. The Getting Started section already points at `content/docs/getting-started.md`, but it does not surface the dedicated training repo. That course is the hands-on path for learning Directive; it should be discoverable from the main product README without hunting the org.

## Proposed change (README only for this issue)

In [`README.md`](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/master/README.md) under **Getting Started** (near the existing first-project tutorial link / situation table), add a short line or row that links:

- **Training course:** https://github.com/deftai/directive-training

Keep the copy brief (one sentence + link). Do not replace the existing `getting-started.md` tutorial pointer.

Optional follow-on (out of scope unless included in the same PR): mirror the same link once in `content/docs/getting-started.md` so the long tutorial and the training repo stay cross-linked.

## Related (not duplicates)

- #4981 — in-session first-run Directive Tutorial (Beacon practice project inside the session). Different surface: product first-run UX, not a README link to the external training repo.
- Public docs site: https://deftai.github.io/directive/

## Acceptance

- [ ] `README.md` Getting Started names and links `https://github.com/deftai/directive-training`
- [ ] Link text makes clear it is the training / learning course
- [ ] Existing install / first-project tutorial links remain

## Origin

Operator ask: file an issue to include the Directive training repo in Getting Started info in the Directive README.
